sources.quote: ODF | Founder Fellowship - From idea to conviction Top Companies FAQ APPLY ODF is an intense one-week in-person experience focused on meeting collaborators, exploring ideas, and gaining conviction. Onboarding Week in SF Befriend talented people at your stage 80-100 participants >50% technical Fellow community platform Get access to our 3,000+ member platform $800k+ in perks Mercury, AWS, Stripe Atlas, and more Non-dilutive We don't take any equity.
